CustomField.label: Data Quality Status
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Decommissioned"), "Retired", IF(Criticality_Score__c = 0, "Not assessed", IF(ISBLANK(LocationId), "No location", IF(OR(ISBLANK(Criticality_Review_Date__c), Criticality_Review_Date__c < TODAY() - 730), "Review overdue", "OK"))))
